collection.title: Saab 9-3 Estate 2002 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Saab 9-3 Estate 2005 to 2007 model requires a 23" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Saab 9-3, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
